title: ProductSubscription and EntitlementProjection
description: ProductSubscription answers exactly one question: which ProductVersion, with which additional profiles/add-ons, has this tenant subscribed to? It never grants capabilities directly -- baobab-platform/baobab-cp expands it into CapabilityGrant rows (capability/v1/grant.schema.json, source=PRODUCT_SUBSCRIPTION, source_reference=subscription_id), and EntitlementProjection is the read-model record of that expansion (Technical Specification SS31, SS91).

subscription_profiles.description: Additional profile/add-on compositions selected for this subscription beyond its ProductVersion's base composition, e.g. ["profile.b2b", "profile.crossborder", "profile.commodity-trade", "profile.supplier-management"] for the ZuriBeans acceptance fixture. Composition expansion (including includes_compositions) is a baobab-cp runtime responsibility, not encoded here.

source_reference.description: Opaque reference to the originating record, e.g. a contract_id when source=CONTRACT. Required whenever source is not ONBOARDING.

classification.description: The subscription's current commercial classification and where it came from (ADR-SHARED-011). Absent only while a subscription has not been classified yet; its history is the SubscriptionClassificationRecord series.

subscriptionClassification.description: The current classification of a ProductSubscription: type plus provenance. The full explanation (eligibility evidence, history) is the SubscriptionClassificationRecord this classification_id names.

classificationReference.description: Opaque reference to the governing record: an admission_decision_id for ADMISSION_DECISION; the governing change, migration batch or decision reference otherwise.

classificationReferenceRule.description: An ADMISSION_DECISION classification references an admission/v1 AdmissionDecision.

SubscriptionClassificationRecord.description: One immutable classification or reclassification of a ProductSubscription (ADR-BCP-017 sections 13, 48; ADR-BCP-018 ORG-11). Reclassification appends a record to the same subscription; it never replaces tenant, organisation or subscription identity. An INTERNAL record always carries server-evaluated InternalEligibilityEvidence, and no other type carries it.

previous_subscription_type.description: Present on a reclassification: the type this record replaced.

classified_by.description: The Control Plane principal accountable for the classification. Never an IAM-internal id.

billingPolicy.description: What a subscription type means for billing (billing-policy.yaml). Only monetary charge and payment execution vary: metering, entitlement control, audit, readiness and isolation are always on.

ClassificationExplanation.description: Answers 'why is this subscription classified as it is?' (ADR-BCP-018 ORG-11) from Control Plane records alone: the current classification record and its provenance, the eligibility re-evaluated now for INTERNAL (so drift is visible), the billing policy that applies, and the full history. For platform operators only; it names relationship identifiers, never the corporate graph.

current_eligibility.description: INTERNAL only: eligibility re-evaluated at evaluated_at. NOT_ELIGIBLE is drift: the classification needs governed review or reclassification, never silent deletion.

policy_reference.description: The governing policy, e.g. 'ADR-BCP-017 section 11 / ADR-BCP-018 ORG-11 INTERNAL policy'.

history.description: Every classification of this subscription, newest first; the first item is current.

capability_key.description: One capability this subscription's composition graph expands to, per member criticality in composition.schema.json.

grant_id.description: The CapabilityGrant this projection materialised, once status=MATERIALIZED. Null while PENDING or FAILED.

failure_reason.description: Set only when status=FAILED, e.g. the composition member's capability_key is not registered.

classificationReason.description: Why the classification is made. Recorded with the classification and in the audit trail.

SubscriptionClassificationCommand.description: Classifies an unclassified ProductSubscription from the APPROVED AdmissionDecision that admitted its tenant's organisation (ADR-BCP-018 ORG-11). The type comes from the decision: the caller supplies neither a type nor eligibility evidence.

SubscriptionReclassificationCommand.description: Changes a classified ProductSubscription's type (ADR-BCP-017 section 48). INTERNAL is accepted only when the Control Plane itself establishes eligibility; the caller supplies no eligibility evidence.
